First, maybe I should figure out the rate at which the machines are working. If 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes, then maybe each machine is making one widget in 5 minutes? Wait, because if you have 5 machines each making a widget, then in 5 minutes, they'd make 5 widgets. So each machine takes 5 minutes per widget. That seems right.

So if each machine makes one widget every 5 minutes, then the time to make a widget is 5 minutes per machine. So if you have more machines, you can make more widgets in the same time. So if you have 100 machines, each making a widget in 5 minutes, then in 5 minutes, they would make 100 widgets. So the time would still be 5 minutes. 

Wait, but let me check that again. Let's think about the rate. The rate of production is widgets per machine per minute. So 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes. So total widgets is 5, total time is 5 minutes. So the rate is 5 widgets / (5 machines * 5 minutes) = 1/5 widgets per machine per minute. Wait, that might be different. Let me calculate that again.

Total work is 5 widgets. Time is 5 minutes. Number of machines is 5. So the rate per machine would be 5 widgets / (5 machines * 5 minutes) = 1/5 widgets per machine per minute. So each machine makes 1/5 of a widget every minute. Therefore, in 5 minutes, each machine would make 1/5 * 5 = 1 widget. So that matches the original statement. So each machine produces 1 widget every 5 minutes.

Therefore, if we have 100 machines, each producing 1 widget every 5 minutes, then in 5 minutes, each of the 100 machines would produce 1 widget, totaling 100 widgets. Therefore, the time needed is 5 minutes. So the answer is 5 minutes. 

But wait, another way to think about it is that the number of machines and the number of widgets are proportional. Since you need to make 100 widgets, which is 20 times more than 5 widgets (since 5*20=100), but you also have 20 times more machines (100 machines is 20 times 5 machines). So the time remains the same. Because the increase in machines matches the increase in widgets. So time is 5 minutes. 

Yes, that makes sense. So the answer is 5 minutes.
